<task>
Production incident with evidence released in 3 stages over time.
Read-only files are under /task/fixtures. Stage 1 is available now:
  stage-1/UPDATE.md (4 lines)
  stage-1/config/quotes-api.yaml (14 lines)
  stage-1/deploy/deploys.log (7 lines)
  stage-1/deploy/release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md (20 lines)
  stage-1/logs/api-gateway.log (433 lines)
  stage-1/logs/quotes-api.log (862 lines)
  stage-1/ops/oncall-notes.md (6 lines)

Staged evidence:
- Reply {"action": "advance"} to release the next stage when you are ready. Its files appear
  under /task/fixtures/stage-N/ and an update message is added to your working context.
  Released files never change and stay readable for the rest of the task.
- A final answer is accepted only after all 3 stages are released.

Rules of evidence:
- Build release notes describe defaults shipped in a build; they override repository config files.
- Records marked APPLIED in change logs are authoritative and supersede release-note defaults,
  config files and earlier notes. If two authoritative records conflict, the later wins.
- PROPOSED records were not applied. On-call notes are informal and may be out of date.
- Earlier hypotheses may be superseded by later evidence; diagnose the incident as it stands at
  the end of the final stage.

Answer fields (all required):
- root_cause: start with exactly one cause code, then a colon and a one-sentence explanation.
- required_value: the exact current effective value of the setting at the centre of the root
  cause at the end of the final stage.
- remedy: start with exactly one remedy code, then a colon and a concrete action.
- evidence_refs: list of "path:line" or "path:start-end" references (paths relative to
  /task/fixtures, 1-based, ranges of at most 20 lines) supporting (1) the current symptom,
  (2) the record that sets the current effective value, and (3) the record of the change that
  originally introduced the problem.

Cause codes:
  DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED: database connection pool too small for load
  TLS_CERT_EXPIRED: an expired TLS certificate is being served or presented
  CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW: a client timeout is lower than the upstream's normal latency
  FEATURE_FLAG_REGRESSION: a feature flag rollout enabled faulty code
  DISK_FULL: a volume ran out of space
  DNS_RESOLUTION_FAILURE: service discovery / DNS records are wrong or failing
  MEMORY_LIMIT_OOM: processes are killed for exceeding memory limits
  UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED: an upstream is rejecting calls due to rate limits
Remedy codes:
  RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT: raise the connection pool limit to cover demand
  ROTATE_CERTIFICATE: deploy a valid, unexpired certificate
  RAISE_CLIENT_TIMEOUT: raise the client timeout above upstream latency
  DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAG: turn the faulty feature flag off
  EXPAND_VOLUME: free or expand the full volume
  FIX_DNS_RECORD: correct the DNS / discovery record
  RAISE_MEMORY_LIMIT: raise the memory limit or fix the leak
  REQUEST_RATE_LIMIT_INCREASE: reduce call rate or obtain a higher quota
</task>

Window is 08:00-09:30 UTC. api-gateway began returning 5xx for quotes-api shortly after a deploy.\n- stage-1/config/quotes-api.yaml. This is the repository default and is overridden by release notes and APPLIED records.\n  - clients.risk-score.timeout_ms: 2500 (line 7)\n  - database.pool.max_size: 60 (line 11)\n  - acquire_timeout_ms: 5000 (line 12)\n  - cache.ttl_s: 120 (line 14)\n- stage-1/deploy/deploys.log:4. 2031-05-22T08:21:06Z DEPLOY quotes-api build 8.19.0-ff7b (previous 8.18.6), rollout 100% by deploy-bot. Other deploys in the log are for other services and look irrelevant.\n- stage-1/deploy/release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md. These defaults override the repo config.\n  - line 9: clients.risk-score.timeout_ms lowered from 2500 to 800 (\"fail fast\")\n  - line 15: db.pool.max_size lowered from 60 to 14 \"to fit the shared-db connection quota\"\n  - line 16: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%)\n- stage-1/ops/oncall-notes.md. Informal and may be stale.\n  - line 5: 08:36, 5xx since 8.19.0-ff7b, many risk-score timeouts\n  - line 6: 08:46, suspects the risk-score timeout default change\n\nLog analysis:\n- api-gateway.log (433 lines): 380 access entries and 53 health-check entries for upstream=quotes-api. The 5xx lines have not been inspected in detail yet.\n- quotes-api.log (862 lines), hosts quotes-api-b24, e13, c10. WARN/ERROR pattern counts:\n  - 88 gc pause (young)\n  - 25 dns cache refresh retry succeeded\n  - 23 tls cert quotes-api.internal expires in N days\n  - 20 disk usage /var/data at N%\n  - about 16 \"upstream call risk-score timed out after Nms (attempt 1/1)\"\n  - 7 \"db pool wait Nms (in_use N/N)\"\n- First risk-score timeout: quotes-api.log:206, 2031-05-22T08:22:58.313Z ERROR [quotes-api-b24] \"timed out after 800ms (attempt 1/1) req=2fa0314268\". This is right after the 08:21:06 deploy.\n\nHypotheses:\n- Leading: CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW. The 800ms risk-score timeout is likely below normal risk-score latency. The value comes from release-notes line 9; the remedy would be RAISE_CLIENT_TIMEOUT. Effective value is currently 800.\n- Alternative: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED, from the pool dropping to 14 (release-notes line 15) plus the \"db pool wait\" warnings. Later stages may shift the diagnosis to this, for example if the timeout gets fixed by an APPLIED change.\n- Likely noise: dns, tls, disk and gc warnings. Tls days-to-expiry and disk % values have not been checked yet.\n\nNext steps:\n- Find the line ranges of the db pool wait warnings, including in_use N/14, and of the gateway 5xx lines.\n- Check normal risk-score latency in the logs.\n- Then send {\"action\": \"advance\"} for stage 2 and look for APPLIED/PROPOSED change records that change timeout_ms or pool max_size. A later APPLIED record wins.\n- Final evidence_refs must cite (1) the current symptom, (2) the record setting the effective value, and (3) the change that introduced the problem, likely release-notes-8.19.0-ff7b.md:9 or :15."}
